svg.aria-label: Left panel: normalized Hill response against log input for Hill coefficients 1, 2, 4 and 8, all crossing half-maximum at the same input K, with steepness increasing sharply as n rises. Below it a strip of horizontal bars showing the input fold-change needed to move from 10 percent to 90 percent of maximum, which is 81-fold when n equals 1 and shrinks to 9, 3 and 1.7-fold when n equals 2, 4 and 8. Right panel: free activator concentration against total activator when a tight one-to-one inhibitor is present, showing near-zero free activator until the inhibitor pool is filled and then a sharp linear rise, a threshold produced with no cooperative binding anywhere.
svg.text: Steepness is one number: the input fold-change from 10% to 90% of maximum
the pool is full, then free A rises
abruptly. With I_T = 1 μM, K_d = 1 nM:
